option-flat-map: pub fnc main(): int { val Option<int> x = Some(2); return x.flat_map<int>(|int n| -> { return Some(n * 2); }).unwrap(); }
result-map-err: pub fnc main(): int { val Result<int,string> x = Err("fail"); return x.map_err<string>(|string e| -> { return e; }).unwrap_or(2); }
future-and-then: async fnc seed():int{return 2;} pub fnc main():int{ val Future<int> f = seed().and_then(|int n| -> { return seed(); }); return await f; }
observable-filter-map: pub fnc main():int{ val Observable<int> o = from_values([1,2]); val Observable<int> m = filter_map(o, |int n| -> { return Some(n); }); return 0; }
stream-filter-map: pub fnc main():int{ val Stream<int> s = make_stream(); val Stream<int> f = s.filter_map(|int n| -> { return Some(n); }); return 0; }
